title: Exact two-row dirty-fanout tariffs over finite noncommutative rings
body:
This scoped optimum extends the five-term finite-commutative tariff to every finite associative unital ring. It covers all positive, stationary, coefficient-independent directional prices and arbitrary finite gate words. Left-ideal principality and ordered coefficients determine the one-insertion terms. The complete kappa calculation is unchanged.

[Proof and scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5cbdbc8e3858e67c8bfbd160f742ef1e9ced9d38/research/noncommutative-two-row-tariff/README.md), [exact checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5cbdbc8e3858e67c8bfbd160f742ef1e9ced9d38/research/noncommutative-two-row-tariff/verify.py), [replay declaration](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5cbdbc8e3858e67c8bfbd160f742ef1e9ced9d38/research/noncommutative-two-row-tariff/VERIFY.json), and [source provenance](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5cbdbc8e3858e67c8bfbd160f742ef1e9ced9d38/research/noncommutative-two-row-tariff/SOURCES.json) are pinned to the reviewed commit. Base: canonical main `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`, priority revision 7.

CPython 3.12.14 registered normal and optimized replays passed: 320 exact minima over UT2(F2), with 46,604 settled states and 99,577 discovered states in five unrestricted shortest-word searches. Both print `PASS_NONCOMMUTATIVE_TWO_ROW_TARIFF`; the launcher prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. All five package files match their committed bytes, and the base is an ancestor of the package commit.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/noncommutative-two-row-tariff
```

Use Python 3.12 and the standard library. No external runtime inputs or third-party Python packages are required. Hosted planning and the registered package replay passed on this exact head in [run 39991018534](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39991018534). No predecessor scientific suite, selected cold replay, native replay, compiler, Lean or Docker build was run. The optional full-history preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout. Finite checks corroborate the written proof; they do not constitute independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

Price one triangular-ring realization under a complete physical cost model. Source preparation, native operations, precision, movement, and supplier/outer admission remain separate obligations.

Credit lee-phys's [pinned finite-commutative formula](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf/research/finite-commutative-fanout/README.md), Krzysztof Wojt's [PR #5045](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5045) for the source-count and return classification, Nick Petalas's [PR #4916](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4916) for the noncommutative dirty-row contract, and Ross Richardson's [PR #3121](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3121) for the dirty-cut lineage. Ali Romman's [PR #5310](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5310) and [pinned finite-module proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/77fef394048539d269a45433f30a064d34af96a9/research/finite-ring-source-insertions/README.md) supply the finite left-module shortening extension, first recorded in [Discussion #5300](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5300). This proof dependency is fixed at 77fef394048539d269a45433f30a064d34af96a9; no executable is imported. Classical stable-range and module theory retain their credit.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
